messages:
elen.design: pushed a variant of the sidebar IA that groups by task domain (Observe / Serve / Manage). figma: https://figma.redwood/console/ia-taskgroups
mark.pm: nice. Heads-up: we must avoid breaking existing deep links customers have saved.
tariq.frontend: propose aliasing old routes to new ones server-side. initially respond with a 302 + banner explaining migration, then switch to 301 later.
jade.a11y: accessibility concern: when groups collapse or reorder, keyboard users lose context. we should move focus to the nearest visible item and announce via aria-live: "Navigation updated, focus on X."
elen.design: agree. we'll include an aria-live message and ensure group headers have `aria-expanded`. for breadcrumbs, I want them to mirror resource hierarchy (Org / Workspace / Page).
mark.pm: about breadcrumbs: also add small action buttons to the right for common tasks rather than inserting verbs into the trail. keeps crumbs consistent for deep links.
tariq.frontend: technical: add `data-legacy-route` attributes so middleware can map old slugs to new canonical paths. log redirect hits for 60 days.
jade.a11y: tiny nit: avoid relying on URL hash fragments for important UI state; prefer path segments and query params because some assistive tech treats hashes inconsistently.
elen.design: path contract draft: `/console/:org/:space/:section/:id` + `?panel=` for ephemeral UI. I'll add this to the spec doc.
mark.pm: rollout: internal canary -> 10% experiment -> 100% with deprecation notices for legacy paths after metrics look stable.
tariq.frontend: dev tasks: alias table, middleware, banner copy, aria-live behavior, keyboard tests. estimate 3 dev days.
ops-bot: Created ticket RED-5010: "Task-group rail IA + redirects + breadcrumb contract" assigned to tariq.frontend; due 2025-10-15.
